description: This Java source file defines the ArrayWrappers class, which provides factory methods and internal classes for wrapping arrays of various primitive types and objects to enable comparison, equality checks, and hashing, primarily for use as keys in data structures within the Spark project.

classes.name: ArrayWrappers
classes.description: A factory class for creating comparable wrappers around arrays of primitive types and objects.

classes.name: ComparableIntArray
classes.description: Wrapper class for int[] arrays, implementing comparison, equality, and hash code methods.

classes.name: ComparableLongArray
classes.description: Wrapper class for long[] arrays, implementing comparison, equality, and hash code methods.

classes.name: ComparableByteArray
classes.description: Wrapper class for byte[] arrays, implementing comparison, equality, and hash code methods.

classes.name: ComparableObjectArray
classes.description: Wrapper class for Object[] arrays, implementing comparison, equality, and hash code methods.

methods.name: forArray
methods.description: Factory method that returns a Comparable<Object> wrapper for the given array object, handling different array types.
